nodes.summary: Catalan's constant is the real number $G = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{(2n+1)^2}$.
nodes.title: Catalan's constant

nodes.summary: The series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{(2n+1)^2}$ converges unconditionally, and its sum is Catalan's constant $G$.
nodes.title: The series for Catalan's constant converges to it

nodes.summary: The series $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{(-1)^n}{(2n+1)^2}$ converges absolutely: its terms are bounded in absolute value by $\frac{1}{(n+1)^2}$, and $\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{1}{(n+1)^2}$ converges.
nodes.title: The series for Catalan's constant converges absolutely
